granularity_problems.issue: f4 glues two distinct, separately-referenced construction stages into one fact: (a) building templates and expression pools via linguistic analysis plus manual verification (Section SECREF16), and (b) presenting the framework for generating simulated training data (Section SECREF20). Each stage is explicitly assigned its own section and is independently describable; a reader could lose the description of one stage and still meaningfully retain the other, so per the protocol's splitting test these are two facts glued into one, not a single bundled cause/rationale.
